purpose.zh: 练背阔肌下压肩带，把身体撑离地面
purpose.en: Train the lats to press the shoulders down and lift your body.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，用肩下压把臀部抬起
text.en: Keep your arms straight and press your shoulders down to lift your hips
Sit with legs long and hands on the floor beside your hips.
Hold for two seconds at the top, shoulders away from your ears.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows to push up.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
